subject: How to get an 'action button' in shiny to get the result (real) from an R code

messages.author: 77f55f86265fddf8
messages.subject: How to get an 'action button' in shiny to get the result (real) from an R code
parts:
Hello everyone,
So I developped in R a code that takes as input a 'returns' table ( I took a multi asset portfolio and the prices of each asset througout the year 2015 and then calculated the log returns ) and calculated the Value at Risk using different methods to get the value of lost at the end( perte). So what I want to do is that when I hit an action button in shiny which I named 'Calculate",it would show the final result of my R code ( which is 'perte'). 

#The code for one method is:

PL <- data.frame(matrix(nrow =nrow(rendements), ncol = ncol(rendements)))
prix <- data.frame( biat = 504999.012, atb = 241937.01, salim = 121130.625, Tunis_ré= 556277.1585, Hannibal_lease = 1771620.48, Best_lease = 927064.53, ATL = 161537.922, UADH = 5291123.292, Monoprix = 63635.88, SITS = 96913.95, Essoukna = 213668.91, Landor = 176913.24, Cérealis = 202065.57, SFBT = 36595.65, Délice_holding = 1704640.0917, TPR = 324576.462, Officeplast = 68908.0035,Sotrapil = 344764.35, sah_lilas = 191264.115, Tawasol_GP_Holding = 607996.032, MIP = 252162.54, MPBS = 413315.049, Sotipapier = 1502315.304, sotuver = 154146.258, telnet_holding = 363970.404, somocer = 345271.3425, siame = 205143.078, Euro_cycles = 258435.6915, New_body_line = 633403.26, Tunisair = 98215.32, Syphax_airlines = 809581.5)

for ( j in 1:ncol(rendements)){
  for (i in 1:nrow(rendements)){
    PL[i,j] <- rendements[i,j]%*%prix[,j]
    PL
  }
}

PL.total <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = nrow(PL)))
for ( i in 1: nrow(PL)){
    
  PL.total[i,] <- sum(PL[i,])
  PL.total
}

tab <- data.frame( PL.tot= PL.total, rang = 1:248) 
tab <- tab[order(tab[,1], decreasing = F),] #tri croissant
cnames <- c("PL.tot", "rang")
colnames(tab)<- cnames
VaR_1j <- (tab[12,])$PL.tot
VaR_10j <- VaR_1j*sqrt(10 )
perte <- VaR_1j / 18643592.86
print(perte)
